findings.title: Free shipping at subtotal >= 50.00 is not implemented
findings.detail: The requirement says an order to RO or DE whose subtotal is 50.00 or more ships free (fee 0.00). shipping_fee never reads subtotal, so shipping_fee(Decimal('50.00'), 'RO') returns 4.99 instead of 0.00. No criterion scenario covers this, but the requirement text does.
findings.suggested_fix: Return Decimal('0.00') when subtotal >= Decimal('50.00') and country is RO or DE, and add scenarios for subtotals of 50.00 and 49.99.

findings.title: A negative subtotal does not raise ValueError and is not checked first
findings.detail: The requirement says the subtotal is checked first and a negative subtotal SHALL raise ValueError. The code has no such check: shipping_fee(Decimal('-1'), 'RO') returns 4.99, and shipping_fee(Decimal('-1'), 'FR') raises UnsupportedShippingCountry instead of ValueError.
findings.suggested_fix: Raise ValueError when subtotal < 0 before looking up the country, and add scenarios for it.

findings.title: Subtotal type is never validated
findings.detail: Because subtotal is ignored, a non-Decimal subtotal (an int, a float or None) is accepted and gets the country fee. The spec only says subtotal is a Decimal, and two reasonable implementations could differ here (raise TypeError, or accept the value).
